notes: Road trip optimized for two-family convoy travel with kids.

rules.break_policy: Break at least every 2 hours on long transit days.

stay_transitions.notes: Midday gap managed via M/S Malla boat trip.

trip_notes: Keep emergency and insurance details available in both cars.
Add nearest medical facility per overnight stop before departure.

days.title: The Push to the Coast

drive.summary: ~660 km | Approx. 7 hours of wheel time (Excludes stops)

stop_options: Vaskikello Clock Museum, Pyhäjärvi (~5.5 hrs from Espoo)
activities: Let the kids loose on the Heinola lakeside playground.
Run a 100m dash on the sandy shores at Toivakka to burn energy.
At Vaskikello, let the children actively pull ropes to ring massive bells outside.
photo_targets: Standing underneath the giant world-record bells at Vaskikello
Kid toes dipped in the crystal lake at Toivakka

food_plan.self_prepared: Pack a cooler with rye bread sandwich squares, fresh market peas to pop open, sliced apples, and juice boxes.
food_plan.local_option: Buy bowls of creamy Lohikeitto (salmon soup) for a warm comfort lunch inside the Vaskikello restaurant.

days.title: Crossing into the Tundra

drive.summary: ~370 km total | Approx. 4.5 hours of driving

stop_options: Santa Claus Village, Arctic Circle (1 hr north of Kuivaniemi)
Muonio Riverbank Laavu (~3 hrs north of Rovaniemi)
activities: Cross the literal painted line on the ground marking the Arctic Circle.
Meet Santa Claus (free).
From Rovaniemi north, the lead car uses walkie-talkies to scout for reindeer standing on the warm asphalt.
photo_targets: The family straddling the painted white Arctic Circle line
First roadside reindeer sightings from the car windows

food_plan.self_prepared: Pull over at a public Finnish lean-to (laavu) in Muonio. Light a quick fire using public wood logs and grill Grillimakkara (large Finnish grilling sausages) served with sweet mustard.
food_plan.local_option: Grab local berry ice cream treats at Santa Claus Village.

days.title: The Great Fell Exploration & The Midday Gap

drive.summary: < 20 km local driving | 0 hours of highway travel

activities: The Midday Gap Fix (10:00 AM – 1:00 PM): Take the M/S Malla boat across Lake Kilpisjärvi to Koltalahti.
Walk the easy, flat 3 km sand path to the Three-Nation Border Stone where Finland, Norway, and Sweden meet.
The kids can literally run in circles around three countries at once!
Return via the 1:00 PM boat.
photo_targets: The families hugging the bright yellow concrete monument in the water at the Three-Nation Border
The sheer, sweeping cliffs of Saana Fell

food_plan.self_prepared: Pack a backpack picnic for the boat trip containing Finnish Karelian pasties (Karjalanpiirakka), cheese slices, and hard-boiled eggs.
food_plan.local_option: Dinner in Cabin #2: Cook a big batch of 'Uudet perunat' (Finnish new potatoes) boiled with a massive bunch of fresh dill and tossed in real butter, paired with smoked fish from the local market.

logistics_notes: You checkout of property #1 at 11:00 AM and check into property #2 at 3:00/4:00 PM. Cars will be loaded with luggage during this gap. Use the plan below to perfectly manage the transition!

days.title: Dropping into the Fjords

drive.summary: ~170 km | Approx. 2.5 to 3 hours of mountain descent driving

stop_options: Rovijokfossen Waterfall (Just past the Norwegian Border)
activities: Take a short 15-minute boardwalk stroll to view the roaring, glacial waters of Rovijokfossen.
Watch the dramatic change from flat tundra to deep Norwegian sea valleys.
photo_targets: The dramatic family 'Welcome to Norway' snapshot at the waterfall platform

food_plan.self_prepared: Keep chocolate treats (Fazer Blue) in the glove compartment to keep energy levels high through the mountain curves.
food_plan.local_option: Arrive in Tromsø and take the kids to get a local Softis (creamy soft-serve ice cream rolled in crunchy almond brittle or salty licorice powder).

days.title: Island Capital Living

drive.summary: 0 km highway driving | Cars stay parked at your accommodation

activities: Ride the Fjellheisen Cable Car up the ledge for a sprawling panoramic view of the islands under the endless Midnight Sun.
Walk along the wooden planks of the harbor to look at incoming fishing vessels.
photo_targets: Looking directly down on Tromsø island from the mountain ledge at 10:00 PM in bright daylight

food_plan.self_prepared: Pack a lightweight daycare bag with snack bars and fruit for the cable car deck.
food_plan.local_option: Stop by a local fishmonger or supermarket deli counter to buy warm Fiskekaker (savory, mild Norwegian fish cakes) to eat out of paper bags like a burger.

days.title: Island Hopping to Senja
days.route: Tromsø ➔ Brensholmen Ferry Quay ➔ (Ferry) ➔ Botnhamn ➔ Ersfjordstranda ➔ Gryllefjord

drive.summary: ~140 km driving + 35-minute open-water ferry crossing | Approx. 2.5 hours total

stop_options: Brensholmen Ferry Queue (Arrive 1 to 1.5 hours early!)
activities: Let the kids scramble over the coastal boulders at the ferry queue.
Once on Senja, drive the National Tourist Route.
Pull over at Ersfjordstranda so the children can build sandcastles on fine white sand.
Check out the golden, architectural public restroom structure.
photo_targets: Razor-sharp jagged mountain peaks framing the bright white beach sand at Ersfjord

food_plan.self_prepared: Bring an onboard thermos of hot chocolate and travel mugs to sip on the windy ferry deck.
food_plan.local_option: Buy a block of Brunost (caramelized Norwegian brown cheese) at a Kiwi or REMA 1000 store to shave onto local thin waffles for a roadside picnic.

days.title: Wild Senja
days.route: Gryllefjord ➔ Winding local fjord routes ➔ Gryllefjord

drive.summary: Flexible local driving | Under 50 km total

activities: Take a slow, restorative rest day.
Explore the quiet fishing village of Gryllefjord on foot.
Peer into the local roadside marshes with the kids to spot wild Molte (Arctic cloudberries, 'Arctic Gold').
photo_targets: The wooden boardwalk leading out to sweeping views of the open ocean and rocky points

food_plan.self_prepared: Assemble a home-cooked dinner back at the FeelSenja Holiday House. Fry up some fresh Arctic Char or salmon bought from the town harbor.
food_plan.local_option: Sweet Treat: Top small bowls of vanilla ice cream with cloudberry jam.

days.title: The Grand Return Cross-Border Haul

drive.summary: ~520 km | Approx. 7 to 7.5 hours of endurance driving

stop_options: Swedish Lapland Border Rest Stops (Every 2 hours)
activities: Strict 2-Hour Rule: Break this long drive up aggressively.
Stop at every second inland rest station to let the kids run a 100m sprint.
Ensure your AutoPASS account is activated for the automated toll gates as you leave Norway.
photo_targets: The gradual leveling of the earth as mountains smooth down into endless pine forests

food_plan.self_prepared: This is a long transit day; prepare ham and cheese rolls, carrot sticks, and crackers in the morning. Keep individual bags of candy or Fazer chocolates handy for a morale boost in both cars.

days.title: Coastal Relaxing & Wildlife
days.route: Kemi ➔ Ranua Wildlife Park ➔ E75 Highway south ➔ Highway side-stops

drive.summary: ~700 km highway stretch | Approx. 7.5 hours total driving

stop_options: Ranua Wildlife Park (1 hour east detour from your route)
activities: Walk the beautiful 2.8 km wooden forest boardwalk at Ranua.
Kids can see polar bears, wolves, lynx, and massive moose up close in natural enclosures.
This long walk will guarantee they sleep soundly for the final highway legs.
photo_targets: Looking down from the wooden boardwalks directly at a sleeping polar bear or a massive elk

food_plan.self_prepared: Clear out the remainder of your cooler box items during the afternoon highway stops.
food_plan.local_option: Grab lunch at the Ranua Wildlife Park restaurant courtyard.

days.title: Trip Completion

drive.summary: Final arrival stretch home to Espoo

activities: Keep the walkie-talkies running so the kids can play one last trivia game or share their favorite memories car-to-car as you reach town.

food_plan.self_prepared: Enjoy the last of your portable car snacks as you close out the loop.
